inputs.description: LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3.6 27B from its checkpoint on one 32 GiB GPU, its frozen base larger than the GPU: the throughput each engine reaches within the GPU memory it holds, and the host memory it needs.

variables.models: the directory holding the Hugging Face checkpoints, one directory per checkpoint
variables.corpora: the directory holding the tokenized corpora prepare_corpus writes, one directory per tokenizer family

post_generation_changes: 2026-10-22: fixed DeepSpeed offload_param to cpu; retained offload_optimizer none/cpu. Case counts reflect this edit.
2026-10-22: set ShadowSpill spill_gib to 160, overriding the generated 144 GiB pool.
2026-10-22: fixed FSDP2 reshard_after_forward and reshard_after_backward to their true defaults; retained prefetch and gradient synchronization sweeps.

2026-10-22: crossed both gradient synchronization modes with every FSDP2 configuration that accumulates multiple microbatches, including all recomputation and activation-offload settings; single-microbatch cases run once. Removed redundant native-prefetch grids already covered by the main grids. FSDP2 has 126 distinct cases.
2026-10-22: reduced the screening sweep to one warmup and one measured update per case after reviewing within-case timing variation in the Llama sweep and corrected FSDP runs.

2026-10-22: removed the 21 explicit-prefetch tuning cases at the user's request; all FSDP2 cases use default forward overlap and automatic backward prefetch (0/auto). FSDP2 has 105 cases and the full experiment has 197.
